t_advice_summary_textbox.text: In each color pair, one will be the one that harvests the most mushrooms. Keep choosing that one until you get diminishing returns then switch to the other color. 0s mean little. 3s can go either way. Focus on colors that return at least 4+ mushrooms. Once the colors receive 1 or 2 mushrooms, it's best to switch to the other gnome.

vb_textbox.text: Look for colors that give you the most mushrooms, anything over 3 mushrooms. Stick with those colors until they give you between 1 or 2 mushrooms multiple times in a row. At which point, you can try switching to the opposing color and see if that yields better results. Receiving 0 or 3 mushrooms, even in a row, has no bearing on which color will typically harvest more mushrooms, so ignore those values.
